why: The results only cover how to set it up. Synology and ASUSTOR give their own setup steps, and the Windows Central and blog pages are tutorials. TechRadar is a paid-hosting roundup that just warns against hosting at home. No source compares or tests NAS models for running WordPress, gives current prices, or works out whether it's cheaper than paying for hosting. A focused page that says which NAS to buy for this, with prices and a cost comparison, would fill the gap.
